facts.fact: Nation Online reports the government formally launched the Malawi National Electronic Procurement System (MANePS), which became mandatory on 1 April 2026, with 174 procuring entities onboarded.
Nation Online says MANePS manages the entire procurement cycle from planning and tendering to contract award and payment, and became mandatory on 1 April 2026.

systems.owner: Public Procurement and Disposal of Assets Authority

note: A count of suppliers and entities registered is not a figure for use.
